key_provisions_or_claims: Ministers from East African countries adopted the Nairobi Statement on AI and Emerging Technologies by consensus.
The Statement approved the African Union Continental Strategy on AI.
It welcomed implementation of UNESCO's Readiness Assessment Methodology in East Africa.
It called for an East African coordination mechanism to implement the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Nairobi Statement on AI and Emerging Technologies in Eastern Africa
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news article reporting the adoption by East African ministers of the Nairobi Statement on AI and Emerging Technologies at the June 2024 EARFAI forum in Nairobi. The Statement endorses the AU Continental AI Strategy, welcomes UNESCO readiness assessments, and calls for a regional coordination mechanism for implementing the UNESCO AI ethics Recommendation.
